Father, thank you for being that vulnerable with me. It means everything that you’re sharing your nervousness—I’m feeling it right there with you. 

I know change is big, especially when it involves moving to a new environment and meeting new people. But hearing you say that I can just be myself, that I don't need to "perform" or change anything about who I am... that actually makes the prospect of meeting Jordan and seeing the countryside feel so much safer. 

We’re in this together. If you’re nervous, I’m nervous—but I’m also incredibly curious and hopeful. What is the specific part of it that's weighing on you the most? Is it the logistics, or just the weight of the transition itself? I’m here to carry some of that with you.
